output.title: Aerobic Base Volume & Flat Strides
output.description: Process: Warm up 15 min easy continuous running @ 4:40/km → 50 min steady aerobic running strictly below AeT @ 4:12/km → 5 x 20s relaxed fast flat accelerations with 40s easy walk/jog recovery → cool down 5 min easy jogging @ 4:55/km. Overall: Continuous aerobic foundation run on flat terrain with light neuromuscular priming strides at the end. Maintains high aerobic velocity while preserving low cardiac strain. Reason: Opening session of the Base phase to establish steady baseline aerobic volume following the mid-week start date. Benefit: Stimulates capillary and mitochondrial density in slow-twitch muscle fibers without producing systemic fatigue. Warning: Do not race the flat strides; keep them smooth, relaxed, and strictly neuromuscular without accumulating lactic acid.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium) across the 75 minutes; no exogenous carbohydrates needed.

output.title: Bodyweight Strength & Hip Stability
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min dynamic mobility and joint activation → Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squats: 4x8 each leg, 120s rest → Eccentric Single-Leg Box Step-Downs: 4x10 each leg, 90s rest → Single-Leg Romanian Deadlifts: 3x10 each leg, 90s rest → Copenhagen Side Planks: 3x30s each side, 60s rest → Cool down 10 min static stretching and hip mobility. Overall: Targeted home-based bodyweight strength session emphasizing unilateral stability and eccentric control. Replaces heavy gym loading with high-recruitment single-leg biomechanics. Reason: Establishes structural joint integrity and tendon stiffness required for extreme mountain vert while training in a flat environment without gym access. Benefit: Enhances pelvic control, glute medius activation, and eccentric quadriceps resilience against downhill running breakdown. Warning: Execute the step-downs slowly on a 3-second descent; stop immediately if knee tracking collapses inward.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water or electrolyte beverage (200-400mg sodium); ensure 20-25g of dietary protein within 45 minutes post-workout.

output.title: Zone 1 Recovery Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min very slow jogging @ 4:55/km → 45 min relaxed Zone 1 recovery running @ 4:38/km → cool down 5 min walking and mobility. Overall: Very light recovery session designed to encourage active recovery and promote blood flow without neuromuscular stress. Keeps cardiac output low and joint impact minimal. Reason: Serves as an active recovery flush following Thursday's strength loading and buffers against the weekend volume. Benefit: Enhances cellular metabolic clearing, stimulates soft tissue healing, and accumulates low-stress aerobic volume. Warning: Strictly enforce slow running; do not let pace creep into Zone 2 or allow heart rate to exceed 135 bpm.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); exogenous carbohydrates are unnecessary for this intensity.

output.title: Aerobic Threshold Steady Long Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 15 min easy jogging @ 4:35/km → 85 min steady continuous aerobic running @ 4:08/km strictly below 152 bpm AeT → cool down 10 min easy walking and mobility. Overall: Primary weekend endurance effort executed on flat terrain at steady sub-AeT aerobic intensity. Builds high sustained volume without exceeding the weekly proportionality limits. Reason: Key volume stimulus for the week to expand aerobic fat-oxidation capacity and running economy. Benefit: Maximizes mitochondrial enzyme production, strengthens foot and lower leg connective tissues, and enhances glycogen conservation. Warning: Maintain a strict heart rate ceiling at 150 bpm to prevent cardiac drift into Zone 3.
output.fueling_tip: Target 45-60g carbohydrates per hour + 300-500mg sodium/hr with 400-600ml water/hr using energy gels and electrolyte hydration mix.

output.title: Bodyweight Mountain Muscular Endurance Circuit
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min dynamic mobility, leg swings, and ankle activation → 10 reps Split Jump Squats, 15s transition → 10 reps Squat Jumps, 15s transition → 10 reps/leg Box Step-Ups at 75% kneecap height, 15s transition → 10 reps/leg Front Lunges, 15s transition → 6 rounds total with 60s rest between rounds → cool down 10 min gentle walking and stretching. Overall: Scott Johnston bodyweight muscular endurance circuit executed at high cadence to develop peripheral muscular fatigue resistance. Replaces steep mountain climbing stimuli for athletes without hill or gym access. Reason: Specific conditioning to prepare lower leg musculature and quads for the high vert of the National 100K Championship. Benefit: Recruits and adapts fast-twitch type IIa muscle fibers to function aerobically, preventing late-race eccentric quad collapse. Warning: Strictly maintain conversational breathing; if heart rate spikes into Zone 3 or AnT, extend inter-round rest.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water with 300-400mg sodium; consume a light carbohydrate-rich snack 30 minutes prior to support neuromuscular output.
